title: Preparata and Del Giudice worked with Fleischmann and Pons on cold fusion

tellings.quote: Yes, they were the scientists that worked together to Fleischmann and Pons.

plain: Two Italian scientists at the University of Milan, Giuliano Preparata and Emilio Del Giudice, are said to have worked with Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons, the pair known for cold fusion, the claim that nuclear fusion can be made to happen at room temperature. A researcher named Filippo Biondi says so on the show, without naming a source: "they were the scientists that worked together to Fleischmann and Pons." The point is that serious physicists took the work seriously over the years from about 1980 onward.
